tagline: Every release checked the way your customers will use it
intro: We test the journeys people take through web and mobile products: sign-up, checkout, settings and the rest. You get a plain report before each release, with every issue written up so your developers can reproduce it.
audience: Product teams at software companies and online retailers across Germany and the Nordics, from a first app release to products with a weekly release train.
pricing_note: A fixed monthly fee per product, sized by how many journeys we cover and how often you release. One-off runs before a launch are quoted per day.

services.title: Release regression runs
services.description: Before each release we run your agreed journeys end to end and send a report: what passed, what broke, and the exact steps to see it break.

services.title: New feature testing
services.description: We test a new flow while it is still in staging, including the odd paths: back buttons, expired sessions, slow networks, half-filled forms.

services.title: Device and browser coverage
services.description: Your key journeys on the phones, tablets and browsers your customers actually use, so a checkout that works on a laptop also works on a two-year-old Android.

services.title: Accessibility journey checks
services.description: We complete your main journeys with a keyboard and a screen reader and report where someone relying on them gets stuck.

process.title: Map the journeys
process.description: We sit with your product team, list the journeys that make you money or lose you customers, and agree which devices and how often.

process.title: Run and report
process.description: Testers work through every journey on real devices. Each issue goes into your tracker with steps, screenshots and the device it happened on.

process.title: Recheck and release
process.description: Once a fix lands we run the journey again and mark it passed, so you ship knowing what was checked and what was not.

proof.text: Their release report is now the last thing we read before we ship.
